welcomeText: उपरि भाषां चिनोतु, ततः संवदितुं कक्षे सम्मिल्यताम् अथवा कक्षं सृजतु।
hint: भवतः नाम कक्षस्य अङ्कं च प्रविशतु। मित्रेभ्यः समानं कक्षाङ्कं दत्त्वा एकत्र संवदत।
voiceListening: शृणोमि… सन्देशं वदतु, अथवा “send”, “clear”, “stop” अथवा “language Sanskrit” इति वदतु।
voiceUnsupported: स्वर आदेशाय Chrome, Edge अथवा Safari आवश्यकम्।
voiceNoSpeech: स्वरः न लब्धः। माइकं नुत्वा पुनः प्रयतस्व।
voiceEmpty: प्रेषणाय किमपि नास्ति। प्रथमं सन्देशं वदतु।
readAloudHint: Choose female or male. Indian languages use your Mac/Windows voices (Hindi: Lekha, Kannada: Soumya, Telugu: Geeta). Install more in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content.
ttsNoIndicVoice: No voice installed for {lang}. On Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices… and download an Indian language voice.
ttsSpeakError: Could not speak this message. Try another language voice in system settings.
roomMuted: Room muted — no auto-read or notifications.
deleteConfirm: Delete this message for everyone in the room?
reportPrompt: Why are you reporting this message?
voiceMessageUnsupported: Voice messages are not supported in this browser.
autoReadHint: When on, new messages are spoken in your selected language.
notifyHint: Alert you when a message arrives while this tab is in the background.
notifyUnsupported: Notifications are not supported in this browser.
